digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflow - pytest macOS cells
propositions: The macOS pytest job is the critical path bottleneck (18.6m of 21-47m gate wall-clock), consuming 15.4m of that time running coverage collection that is never consumed.

Coverage collection via coverage.py is redundant on macOS because the identical 7856-test suite is run on three ubuntu cells which enforce the identical fail_under floor, making macOS coverage duplicate work.
The macOS runner pool is concurrency-limited (peak 4 concurrent observed), causing later changes to queue 6.7-8.4m waiting for a runner; reducing macOS job duration frees the scarce resource.

The proposed fix (conditional --cov flags per OS in the workflow matrix) removes tracing overhead from macOS without losing coverage enforcement, and preserves the identical test selection on both platforms.
